reasons.personal_attributes: The ad talks about the reader's own health or problem ("Are you…?"). Meta doesn't allow that.
reasons.health_appearance: The picture or words compare "before and after" or focus on someone's body.
reasons.misleading_solar: It promises a result Meta thinks can't be proven, like a guaranteed saving.
reasons.political: Meta may treat a government scheme name as a political ad, which needs extra verification.
reasons.special_category: Ads for property, loans or jobs need a special Meta setting AdBrain doesn't support yet.
reasons.destination: People who tap can't reach you: the WhatsApp number or link isn't working.
reasons.low_quality: The headline reads like clickbait to Meta.
reasons.brand_ip: The picture uses a logo Meta doesn't allow, like a changed WhatsApp icon.
reasons.prohibited: Meta doesn't allow ads for this product or service.
reasons.adult: Meta thinks the picture shows too much skin.
reasons.personal_attributes_ielts: The ad talks about the reader's own result, like a past test score or a visa refusal. Meta doesn't allow that. Talk about your classes instead.
reasons.misleading: It promises a result Meta thinks can't be proven, like a guaranteed result.
reasons.misleading_ielts: It promises a result Meta thinks can't be proven, like a guaranteed band, visa or admission.
reasons.misleading_interiors: It promises a result Meta thinks can't be proven, like the lowest price or a fixed handover date.
reasons.job_or_visa_offer: Meta read this as a job or visa offer. Keep it about the course and add your licence number as the last line.
reasons.special_category_interiors: Meta read this as a property ad. Talk about kitchens and design, not flats, projects or prices per square foot.

hints.licence: Add your licence number as the last line, e.g. 'Punjab licence no. 123'.
hints.misleading_ielts: Take out 'guaranteed', '100%' or any promised band, visa or admission.
